name: usage-meter
title: Usage Meter
description: What fills an allowance: segments grow into the bar in turn as the figure counts up, and the rest warns near the limit.

perf.budget: Plain views: two shared values per segment, and a figure that re-renders on frames only while it counts. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The bar and the figure show their values at once.
a11y.screenReader: One progress indicator named by the title, whose value reads the total, what is left and every segment.
